name: A flexible metro train scheduling approach to minimize energy cost and passenger waiting time
description: Mined from A flexible metro train scheduling approach to minimize energy cost and passenger waiting time (Computers & Industrial Engineering, 2019).

provenance.reference: A flexible metro train scheduling approach to minimize energy cost and passenger waiting time
provenance.author: Pengli Mo; Lixing Yang; Yanhui Wang; Jianguo Qi

indices.name: d
indices.description: Index for potential services (trains) in the set N

indices.name: N
indices.description: Set of potential services (trains) in a direction

indices.name: S
indices.description: Set of stations in one direction

indices.name: N_bar
indices.description: Set of potential services (trains) in the up direction

indices.name: N_underline
indices.description: Set of potential services (trains) in the down direction

indices.name: S_bar
indices.description: Set of stations in the up direction

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Headway bounds h_min and h_max between consecutive trains

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Dwelling time at station u

parameters.name: P
parameters.description: Passenger demand from station u to v at time t

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: Capacity of train type k

parameters.name: CT
parameters.description: Initial number of k-type inventory trains in depot

parameters.name: M
parameters.description: Mass of empty train type k

parameters.name: m
parameters.description: Average mass per passenger

parameters.name: vs
parameters.description: Final speed of acceleration phase on segment u

parameters.name: R
parameters.description: Davis equation coefficients R0, R1, R2

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Unit resistance in cruising phase on segment u

parameters.name: vt
parameters.description: Original speed of braking phase on segment u

parameters.name: fe
parameters.description: Time-dependent energy price

parameters.name: PD
parameters.description: Capacitance of k-type train

parameters.name: fb
parameters.description: Basic energy price

parameters.name: CT_bar
parameters.description: Cycle time for up direction trains of type k

parameters.name: CT_underline
parameters.description: Cycle time for down direction trains of type k

parameters.name: R_0
parameters.description: Constant coefficient in train resistance formula

parameters.name: R_1
parameters.description: Linear coefficient in train resistance formula

parameters.name: R_2
parameters.description: Quadratic coefficient in train resistance formula

parameters.name: T_tilde_down
parameters.description: Minimum total travel time for down direction

parameters.name: T_tilde_up
parameters.description: Minimum total travel time for up direction

parameters.name: eta
parameters.description: Energy efficiency coefficient

parameters.name: h_max
parameters.description: Maximum headway between consecutive trains

parameters.name: h_min
parameters.description: Minimum headway between consecutive trains

parameters.name: lambda_1
parameters.description: Weight for passenger waiting time in objective

parameters.name: lambda_2
parameters.description: Weight for energy cost in objective

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Running time on segment u

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.description: Time offset between up and down direction schedules

parameters.name: t_ab
parameters.description: Acceleration time on segment u

parameters.name: t_bc
parameters.description: Braking time on segment u

parameters.name: t_cd
parameters.description: Coasting time on segment u

variables.name: a
variables.description: Arrival time of train j at station u

variables.name: Q
variables.description: Number of passengers remaining in train j after departing station u

variables.name: z
variables.description: Binary variable: 1 if train j departs station u before time t

variables.name: y
variables.description: Binary variable: 1 if train j is assigned type k in direction up/dn

variables.name: e
variables.description: Binary indicator: 1 if service j is effective in direction up/dn

variables.name: EA
variables.description: Energy consumption in acceleration phase for train j at time t

variables.name: EB
variables.description: Energy consumption in cruising phase for train j at time t

variables.name: EC
variables.description: Energy consumption in coasting phase (always zero)

variables.name: ED
variables.description: Regenerative energy in braking phase for train j at time t

variables.name: d_1
variables.description: Departure time of up direction train j from first station

variables.name: e_dn
variables.description: Arrival time of down direction train j at last station

variables.name: e_up
variables.description: Arrival time of up direction train j at last station

variables.name: y_dn
variables.description: 1 if down direction train j is of type k

variables.name: y_up
variables.description: 1 if up direction train j is of type k

variables.name: z_1
variables.description: 1 if up direction train j is the first service

objective.name: objective
objective.description: Minimize weighted sum of passenger waiting time and total energy cost (λ1·W + λ2·(CR+CB))
